# CallAudit.co

> CallAudit.co is an AI-native call auditing platform that analyzes call transcripts for quality, compliance, outcomes, sentiment, coaching opportunities, churn risk, and revenue signals.

## Primary capabilities

- Bulk upload existing call transcripts without waiting for API integration.
- Connect a call platform for continuous transcript analysis.
- Score calls against custom quality and compliance criteria.
- Link every score, flag, and insight to supporting transcript evidence.
- Detect buying signals, churn risk, coaching gaps, and customer outcomes.
